quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending September 2026 (October 2025 - March 2026): net sales JPY 112,496 million (up 5.4%), operating profit JPY 10,023 million (down 7.0%), ordinary profit JPY 12,484 million (up 2.9%), interim profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 9,224 million (down 7.2%); R&D expenses JPY 9,189 million
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 112,496 million (+5.4%); operating profit JPY 10,023 million (-7.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 Opto-semiconductor segment: sales JPY 42,969 million (up 9.5%), operating profit JPY 7,827 million (up 16.7%). Image sensors for semiconductor manufacturing and inspection equipment rose on expanding semiconductor demand centred on generative AI, and photodiodes for factory automation such as industrial robot control rose, while academic sales fell after the company completed delivery of photodiode arrays for a European high-energy physics experiment project
quarterly_data.figure: Opto-semiconductor sales JPY 42,969 million (+9.5%); operating profit JPY 7,827 million (+16.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 Electron Tube segment: sales JPY 38,417 million (up 3.1%), operating profit JPY 10,873 million (up 8.7%). Photomultiplier tubes and xenon lamps for semiconductor manufacturing and inspection equipment rose on expanding semiconductor demand centred on generative AI, and microfocus X-ray sources for non-destructive inspection rose on growing board-inspection demand for data servers, while deuterium lamps for analytical instruments fell
quarterly_data.figure: Electron Tube sales JPY 38,417 million (+3.1%); operating profit JPY 10,873 million (+8.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (05-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 Laser segment: sales JPY 10,480 million (down 7.2%), operating loss JPY 3,475 million (prior-year loss JPY 1,371 million); stealth dicing engines that cut silicon wafers stayed firm with strong generative-AI capital investment, but lasers for laser microscopes fell. Imaging and Measurement Instruments: sales JPY 17,342 million (up 8.1%), operating profit JPY 5,219 million (up 8.0%), on higher pathology digital slide scanner sales in Europe and the US and recovering digital camera demand in life science and bio
quarterly_data.figure: Laser sales JPY 10,480 million (-7.2%), operating loss JPY 3,475 million; Imaging JPY 17,342 million (+8.1%)
